1: A beginning position: the structure is still taking shape.
Small shifts register clearly because nothing has settled yet.
2: A supporting position: the pattern stabilizes through placement and backing.
What holds the center matters more than what announces itself.
3: A threshold position: pressure builds where momentum meets constraint.
Timing and sequence decide whether force becomes friction.
4: An entering-visibility position: actions start meeting external response.
Responsibility increases as the pattern becomes more seen.
5: A central position: influence concentrates and expectations gather here.
Small deviations carry wider impact because the node is load-bearing.
6: An end position: the pattern nears completion, spillover, or reversal.
Release becomes part of the structure when extension reaches its limit.

fallback.core_image: The shape is still indistinct, like mist that has not lifted from the water.

core_structure: Signals point in more than one direction at once.

structure.inherent_tension: The mind keeps trying to force a clean story before the pattern has enough edges.
